content.value_statement: Marketing teams need defensible ROI numbers from scattered campaign data. This skill calculates ROI, ROAS, EMV, attribution, LTV, and influencer-level value.
actual_capabilities: Calculates direct ROI, profit, and ROAS from spend and revenue inputs.
Estimates earned media value from impressions, engagements, CPM, and CPE assumptions.
Compares CPM, reach cost, CPE, CPV, CPC, CPA, and CAC against benchmarks.
Models first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based attribution.
Projects LTV-based ROI and ranks results by influencer or tier.
Produces a stakeholder summary with bottom line and recommendations.
limitations: It depends on accurate spend, revenue, conversion, and customer inputs from the user.
Live integrations require connector support from the host environment.
EMV outputs are directional estimates, not audited revenue.
It produces ROI numbers and summaries, not a full slide deck or written report.

use_cases.title: Defend Campaign Spend
use_cases.description: Turn campaign spend and revenue data into ROI, ROAS, profit, and benchmark status for leadership review.

use_cases.title: Compare Attribution Models
use_cases.description: Evaluate first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based revenue views before reporting final performance.

use_cases.title: Rank Creator Value
use_cases.description: Compare influencer-level ROI and tier performance to guide renewals, budget shifts, and future creator selection.

prompt_templates.title: Calculate Basic ROI
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate direct ROI for this influencer campaign. Spend: [amount]. Revenue: [amount]. Reach: [amount]. Show profit, ROI, ROAS, and assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Compare ROI Methods
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare direct ROI, ROAS, and EMV for this campaign. Use these inputs: [spend, revenue, impressions, engagements, CPM, CPE].

prompt_templates.title: Model Attribution and LTV
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate attribution-modeled ROI and LTV-based ROI. Include first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based views.

prompt_templates.title: Build Executive Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an executive ROI summary for this influencer campaign. Include benchmark status, CVI-ready ROI score, risks, and three recommendations.

output_examples.input: Spend was $25,000, revenue was $72,000, and reach was 2.1 million.
output_examples.output: Direct ROI: 188%. ROAS: 2.88:1. Profit: $47,000. The campaign exceeded a 2:1 ROAS benchmark.

output_examples.input: A campaign had $40,000 spend, $95,000 revenue, 600 new customers, and $180 average LTV.
output_examples.output: Direct ROI: 137.5%. LTV-based ROI: 170%. The LTV view strengthens the case for continued investment.

output_examples.input: Five creators have separate fees, revenue, clicks, and conversions.
output_examples.output: The output ranks creators by ROI and ROAS, then highlights the strongest tier and budget reallocation options.

best_practices: Provide spend, revenue, conversion, and customer data in the same currency and date range.
Separate direct revenue, EMV, and LTV outputs so stakeholders know which value model they are reading.
State assumptions for CPM, CPE, attribution weights, benchmarks, repeat rate, and lifetime value.
anti_patterns: Do not treat EMV as confirmed revenue.
Do not mix campaign periods or currencies in one ROI calculation.
Do not report one attribution model without explaining why it fits the customer journey.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs spend, revenue, reach, impressions, engagements, clicks, conversions, and customer data when available.

faq.question: Can it calculate ROAS?
faq.answer: Yes. It divides revenue by investment and explains the return per dollar spent.

faq.question: Does it support earned media value?
faq.answer: Yes. It estimates EMV from impressions, engagements, CPM, and CPE assumptions.

faq.question: Can it compare influencers?
faq.answer: Yes. It can rank individual influencers and tiers by investment, revenue, ROI, and ROAS.

faq.question: Does it pull live analytics data?
faq.answer: Only if the host provides compatible connectors. Otherwise, the user supplies the numbers.

faq.question: Is this a full report generator?
faq.answer: No. It creates ROI calculations and summaries. A separate report skill should build the full report.
